title: If I used Ai to pack textures and make Atlases, is it considered ai generated assets
author: AhmedMostafa_dev
selftext: Hi there I have a 2d game that's ui heavy and I want to pack textures to reduce build size and memory usage in the game, I was wondering if I used Ai agent to pack the textures and make some Atlases does the generated sprites are Ai generated assets I should report a disclosure for Ai generated assets

Btw, people in this sub have a vested interest in legitimazing AI generated artwork and will not give you accurate information.

comments.author: taisui
comments.body:
No it doesn't count, you are just moving stuff it's not generative.  The way you know is that your atlas combination, is not visible to the users, meaning if you had not used atlas and kept the textures as separate files, the users won't see any difference.

Alternatively if your texture and models are touched by AI, then those when rendered the users can see, then you need disclosure per store policies.
